_about:
Coach Osama's permanent B-roll library (his own training / demo footage). Files are NOT in git: download by Drive id into library/broll/files/ (curl -L "https://drive.usercontent.google.com/download?id=ID&export=download&confirm=t"), check sha256, then hard-link into projects/

/source/. Reuse whenever a clip genuinely serves a beat.

clips.content: He sits on a gym box in a black tank, smiling and talking/laughing to camera, holding a can; short double-biceps at ~3.4 s.
Physique check-in poses in a black tank, dark gym: hands on hips front, front double biceps (~4.5 s), side pose (~7.5 s), side chest (~10-16 s).
Check-in poses in a bright gym, black tank: front relaxed (~2 s), front lat/abs (~7 s), double biceps (~11.8 s), side chest (~16.5 s), side + back (~21-26 s).
He stands in a mint long-sleeve top, hands on hips then clasped, looking off to the side (thoughtful / confident).
